facts.business: SRG Fingrow Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) engaged in providing loans and advances.
key_risks: Credit risk with 35 loan accounts having irregular repayments
Overdue loans exceeding 90 days amounting to Rs. 72.45 Lakhs and over 150 days amounting to Rs. 10.58 Lakhs
No credit rating as of March 31, 2026
Dependence on promoter directors for management
Small scale of operations with loan portfolio of Rs. 732.93 Lakhs
facts.related_party_note: Promoter directors Mr. Vinod K. Jain and Mrs. Seema Jain are spouses. Promoter group includes Vinod Kumar Jain, Seema Jain, Jikisha Jain, Vinod Jain HUF, Archis Jain, SRG Housing Finance Limited, Rhythm Consultants Private Limited, Ambitious Associates Private Limited, Ravi Parasmal Jain, Hriday Jain, Genda Lal Jain, Pushpa Jain, Rajesh Jain, Genda Lal Jain HUF, Aarti Jain.
